description: Build a pre-filled madmaxsupply.com cart link for the buyer. Does NOT place an order or charge anything: the buyer opens the link, enters the address and pays on Stripe-hosted checkout. Optional auto_ship_months (1, 2, 3, 6 or 12) sets up Subscribe & auto-ship on eligible items.

ship_to_zip.description: Optional 5-digit ship-to ZIP; some regions add a shipping surcharge at checkout.
